notes: The reversed-limit pitfall is avoided. However, the proof adds an unjustified C² hypothesis; integrability does not imply this. For f(x)=|x| on [-1,1] with n=1, the trapezium error is 2−1=1, but f'' is zero wherever defined and undefined at 0, so no ξ satisfies the formula. The derivation is valid only under its stronger assumptions.
